# hypjam logo assets

a mix of two directions from the concept board: **the hook** (1d) and **shot on a phone** (1i).
all files are plain SVG with no fonts embedded (the lettering is drawn paths), so they render identically everywhere.

## colours
- ground `#0a0a0a` · paper `#f4f4f4` · jam `#ff6f1f` (the play triangle is always jam)

## files
| file | what it is | use it for |
|---|---|---|
| hypjam-mark-*.svg | phone with the hook on screen — the primary mark | avatars, app icons, nav, anything 48px and up |
| hypjam-lockup-*.svg | primary mark + hook wordmark, horizontal | site header, decks, invoices, signage |
| hypjam-icon.svg + icon-*.png | hook on a black plate | favicon, app icon, any tiny square slot |
| hook-mark-*.svg | the j-hook alone | stamps, stickers, watermarks, favicon |
| hook-wordmark-*.svg | "hypjam" in the monoline lettering | headers where there's room, merch |
| phone-mark-*.svg | the phone with a plain play | social stories, "shot on a phone" moments |
| *-animated-*.svg | looping CSS animation baked into the SVG | site header, intro stings; open in a browser to preview |

`-on-dark` = for dark backgrounds (paper ink). `-on-light` = for light backgrounds (ground ink).

## rules
- minimum sizes: hook mark 24px; primary mark 48px; lockup 160px wide.
- below 48px use `hypjam-icon` (the hook on a plate), not the phone — the hook inside the phone screen is too small to read.
- clear space around any mark = the height of the mark.
- don't recolour the play triangle, don't rotate or add shadows/glows.
- the wordmark is drawn lettering; the brand guide's Outfit 700 rule still applies to all other type.
